title: Seacrest Beach 183 Geoff Wilder Lane
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Walking distance to the beach and Rosemary- Gulf view from third floor- Private heated pool **Pool heating available October 1-May 1 for $25 per day**- Professionally decorated- Wifi- 4 adult bikes - Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, laundered upon every checkout*Spring Break 2026- Water's Edge community will have a 7pm curfew for unaccompanied minors under age 18 without parental supervision from March 1st through April 19, 2026.DETAILS: Your perfect beach vacation awaits at 183 Geoff Wilder! In Seacrest Beach, you'll find this adorable 4-bedroom, 4-bathroom home with accommodations for 10 guests. It's been professionally decorated and is spacious enough for entertaining indoors or outdoors. The home is ideally located in a gated community on the south side of 30A, just 100 yards from the community private beach and directly next door to Rosemary Beach, making it an easy walk or bike ride with the provided adult bikes. The home's first floor features an open living area and kitchen with premium appliances and custom cabinetry. The gourmet kitchen is fully stocked to prepare a meal for you and your guests to enjoy at the dining table, which seats 8, or at the breakfast bar. There is plenty of seating around the flat-screen TV in the living room on the oversized sectional. Step outside to the home's backyard and pool deck, where you'll find reclining lounge chairs and a private, heated pool. There is one bedroom suite on the first floor which features a king bed and a bathroom that is shared with the hallway. Upstairs, you'll find the primary suite and a bunk room on the second floor. The primary has a king bed, balcony access, and a spacious, private bathroom with dual vanities and a shower. The bunk room has 2 twin-over-twin bunk beds and a private bathroom - perfect for the kids! The top floor has another large suite, which has a king bed, private bathroom with single vanity, and private balcony with Gulf views! It's the perfect spot for guests who prefer extra privacy and the added luxury of having a covered balcony to enjoy. The home's convenient proximity to the beach, 30A, and private pool make it a fantastic option for multi-generational families or groups of all ages. It truly allows you to have the best of both worlds! Don't miss your chance to book 183 Geoff Wilder and book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 10):FIRST FLOOR: - Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom With Shower/Tub ComboSECOND FLOOR: - Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom, dual vanities With Large Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Two Twin/Twin Bunk Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower Tub ComboTHIRD FLOOR: - Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Tub Combo *Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.*The Water's Edge Board of Directors has instituted a curfew for everyone 18 years old and under of 8:00 PM effective immediately!This curfew will follow the same guidelines put forth by Rosemary Beach and they consist of:1. Curfew for anyone under the age of 18 not accompanied by their parents. They will be asked to return to their rental property or leave Water's Edge if they are not guests.Refusal may result in criminal charges.Security will be on premises and will be verifying they are guests of Water's Edge.2. No backpacks, coolers, bags, etc., capable of concealing alcohol or other illegal contraband will be allowed.3. Dry beach (no alcohol) 8:00 PM to 6:00 AM.This curfew will extend for the duration of Fall Breaks and may extend past that time at the direction of the Board of Directors, depending on compliance and the safety of the community.
